after_entry.name: MaltExtract
after_entry.role: Target-species RMA extraction and alignment/damage-related summaries
after_entry.coverage_note: The P002 supplementary DOCX names MaltExtract for target candidate extraction followed by manual summary/damage assessment. A declared1.7 software profile is now qualified for those output-producing operations; unreported author choices are not inferred.
after_entry.implementation_scope: Supervised unchanged original MaltExtract1.7 from the GPL HOPS0.35 distribution, with exact Linux OpenJDK8.0.144 runtime, literal target-name lookup, source-specific descendant selection, complete RMA6 snapshots, original target FASTA/BLAST extraction and all original summary/damage/coverage/distribution tables. Explicit source-default, complete-default and complete-def-anc profiles; complete profiles deliberately disable destacking, duplicate removal and downsampling. Native Java audits complete stored classes/counts and complete-profile read multisets. Manual candidate assessment remains a human task. Author version/settings/resources are unreported; the historical91-spirochete and7508-genome screening analyses and whole MALT/HOPS remain separate. Read MALTEXTRACT_INTEGRATION.md.
after_entry.validation_note: Seven complete original productions,516 byte-identical scientific-file comparisons with independent originals,76027 original descendant cases and16 complete-map name cases. All21 focused tests passed without skips/failures. Complete saved replay passed on Windows JDK21/25 and Linux JDK21, including8 rehashed contradiction refusals per platform. Five failed attempts are retained, including original SEVERE output errors with exit0. A complete10001-read RMA showed stock processing stopping at10000 with downSampling? Off; the complete default profile retained10001. Saved verification does not independently recalculate arbitrary damage/coverage cells, repeat original fitting, authenticate a producer or establish biological accuracy.
